title: Zesty Crispy Middle Eastern Eggplant Baba Ganoush
description: A winey, crispy, one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring serrano ham and dashi extract, served in a baba ganoush form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the eggplant cubes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the eggplant cubes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced serrano ham until it is crispy.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the roasted eggplant, dashi extract, and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the baba ganoush hot, garnished with additional paprika and lemon wedges if desired.
